title: Admin and paid ElevenLabs voice with invoice-derived spend caps
acceptance: A dedicated Cloudflare Access application authenticates human administrators; the Worker verifies issuer, audience, signature, token type and lifetime, while public reading remains available without sign-in.

Verified administrators can voice their own material through the Worker without a Plus purchase, sharing a separate daily character ceiling and explicitly configured monthly dollar budget no higher than $5, under the global daily cap; no browser role flag or unverified token grants authority, and no administrator subject/email is persisted.

Subscribers have an invoice-derived voice-cost ceiling of at most half the policy net collected amount, bounded by 105,000 characters per paid period and the subscriber/global daily caps; zero-paid, replayed, refunded, unrelated and outdated invoices do not mint extra budget.

Atomic reservations protect concurrent requests; historical costs retain their reservation rate, billed or uncertain vendor outcomes remain charged, and refusal leaves reading usable without the voice.

Privacy, terms and operations disclose variable allowance, admin identity processing and server financial/usage records; RISE stores no reading text or audio server-side and the provider key never reaches the client.

Required CI passes for each implementation PR, exact production release/configuration is verified, and a real administrator and paid subscriber exercise the sign-in, voicing, spend-boundary and browser-cache paths. Automated or branch evidence alone is not acceptance.
